summary: Ansible Lightspeed intelligent assistant is GA in AAP 2.6 on OpenShift: an embedded English chat using LLMs to answer AAP questions; it needs AAP 2.6 on OpenShift and an LLM hosted on RHEL AI or OpenShift AI.
questions: What do I need to run the Ansible Lightspeed intelligent assistant?
Is the Lightspeed intelligent assistant available on RPM installs?
Which LLM services work with Ansible Lightspeed intelligent assistant?

answer_card.title: Lightspeed intelligent assistant requirements
answer_card.answer_md:
- Ansible Automation Platform **2.6 on OpenShift Container Platform**
- An LLM service hosted on **Red Hat Enterprise Linux AI** or **Red Hat OpenShift AI**

It's a chat interface in AAP that answers questions in English. See *Deploying the Ansible Lightspeed intelligent assistant on OpenShift Container Platform*.
